remarks:
Why rent when you can own? Welcome to 1286 Bloomingdale Road! Set on a manageable .27-acre lot with no rear neighbors, this 3-bedroom ranch offers convenient first-floor living with many of the big-ticket updates already completed. An additional separate .71-acre lot located directly behind the property will also convey with the sale, bringing the total acreage to approximately .98 acres!
Inside, you’ll find three good-sized bedrooms, first-floor laundry, and a bright living room with space for a dining area. The kitchen was updated approximately four years ago and features white cabinetry, a modern backsplash, and stainless steel appliances that are also approximately four years old.
Major improvements include a 2024 full tear-off roof with new overhang eaves and new siding, public water connection, newer hot water tank, all-new PEX plumbing throughout, and updated electrical throughout. The full basement has been professionally waterproofed by Frank’s Basement Systems and includes a transferable warranty, providing plenty of room for storage with potential for additional usable space.
Out back, the deck provides a great spot to relax or entertain while overlooking the backyard and additional acreage. Conveniently located near fuel, shopping, dining, local amenities, and the Tonawanda Indian Reservation, while also being just minutes from the I-90 Thruway for easy access to surrounding areas.
With nearly an acre of combined property and many of the major improvements already taken care of, this could be your opportunity to trade the rent payment for a place to call your own. Welcome home to 1286 Bloomingdale Road!
